outOfScope: Changing release workflow behavior, release-preflight validation semantics, release metadata, tags, provider Releases, or archived evidence.

sources.reason: Authoritative lifecycle documentation that incorrectly leaves the local premerge versus hosted runtime preflight boundary implicit.
Working reference: runtime freeze and release preflight execute on the exact detached merged source.
Defines premerge finalization from clean candidate HEAD and runtime finalization from the exact release source.
Requires Japanese assessment and release evidence to bind to the exact checked-out source.

riskAssessment.reason: An ambiguous release-stage command can induce a false local failure or an unsafe retry; this corrective changes only the documented and tested order.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized correction of discovered process issues before publication; the runtime workflow and failing local invocation provide deterministic evidence.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The lifecycle guide distinguishes premerge candidate preparation from exact-source runtime publication verification and names the only phase in which check-release-preflight is valid.
The guide states that premerge freeze metadata must be committed without treating the resulting metadata commit as the release source identity.
An executable regression verifies the release workflow retains runtime freeze before release preflight and the lifecycle guide states the same ordering.
Focused documentation and workflow regression checks pass without changing release behavior or immutable release identities.
A Contract-declared optional check recorded as not_run does not prevent readiness promotion, while every required check must still pass.
guidelines: Preserve fail-closed release identity and exact-source verification boundaries.
Describe premerge and runtime phases without implying that a metadata commit is the release source.
Use an executable regression for the documented workflow ordering.
Respect Contract-required verification boundaries; never treat an explicitly optional check as passed.

intent.problem: The v0.5.45 preparation exposed that the lifecycle guide says to run check-release-preflight after premerge metadata is committed, even though that gate requires a detached exact source checkout and therefore rejects the metadata commit by design.
constraints: Do not change the provider release workflow or weaken its exact-source preflight.
Do not mutate release metadata, tags, provider Releases, or archived Work Item evidence.
Use focused checks under the user-authorized temporary efficiency agreement.
Do not weaken readiness when any Contract-required check is failed or absent.
intent.rationale: A documented and tested phase boundary prevents future agents from treating the expected local rejection as a release defect or attempting unsafe retries before publication.
